name: Section Map
description: Visual song-section map and navigation. Optional: Difficulty Ladder adds a per-section difficulty tier rail.

difficulty-ladder.description: Optional peer plugin, used for the difficulty tier rail only; section navigation, layout and seeking are standalone. Prefers the peer's render-neutral difficulty_ladder.sections.v3 payload (feature-detected via window._ddCapabilities.sectionsSchema), falling back to the frozen difficulty_ladder.sections.v2 sectionDifficulties payload (payload floor: Difficulty Ladder v0.12.0) behind window._ddCapabilities.sectionDifficulty. No peer, a peer that doesn't advertise the marker, or a payload entry we can't read all mean no rail rather than an error.
